definitions.explanation: A woman on her wedding day or about to be married.
A married woman (from the perspective of her husband or his family).

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}の{嫁|よめ}が{来月|らいげつ}{来|く}る。
examples.english: My son's wife is coming next month.
To get married (said of a woman).
examples.notes: 嫁に行く = to marry into another family

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}を{嫁|よめ}にもらった。
examples.english: I took her as my wife.
examples.notes: 嫁にもらう = to take as a wife (traditional expression)

notes:
USAGE: {嫁|よめ} can mean (1) bride, (2) wife (casual/informal), or (3) daughter-in-law. The meaning depends on context and the speaker's perspective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{嫁|よめ}に{行|い}く (to get married - for women)
・{嫁|よめ}にもらう (to take as a wife)
・{嫁|よめ}さん (wife - casual/affectionate)
・お{嫁|よめ}さん (bride)

RELATED:
・{花嫁|はなよめ} - bride (at wedding)
・{婿|むこ} - groom, son-in-law
・{妻|つま} - wife (formal)
